title: Keurajeuen teumpat akhe peurintah hana deuh .
intro: Seujarah ka geuturi peunguasa nibak mandum jeunèh, tapi bacut mantong nyang geubri peurintah keu domain nyang cukôp lagèe nyoe. Dipat angen keudroe geujaweueb peurintah awaknyan dan pekerja hana mata fana nyang jeuet jikalon jimeukeureuja brat lam seungap, masa peumeurintahan nyoe hana saban ngon masa sigohlom atawa lheueh. Bah pih meunan, keurajeuen nyang paleng rayeuk pih harôh teuma akhé-dan watée keurajeuen nyoe teuka, keubeunaran nyan teuka nibak sumber nyang that miyueb sampoe hana meusidroe pih nyang jipike keu jicuriga keuhai nyan.
clues: Lon geubri keurajeuen nyang luah le Tuhan lon, geupeugah haba di linteung halaman-halaman suci.
Lon meuwarisi hikmah dan otoritas nyang rayeuk dari sidroe ureung chik nyang ka geujak di keu lon deungon bakti.
Ulôn peurintah angén, dan angén nyan jijak jiôh keu tujuan Ulôn.
Makhluk-makhluk nyang hana deuh le mata biasa meukeureuja dimiyueb otoritas lon, jipeugot keajaiban nyang hana teubandeng.
Mata ië teumaga cair meu-ile keu ulôn, saboh nikmat njang unik di antara njang ka geupiléh lé Allah.

Watee lon tinggai donya nyoe, tuboh lon teutap teudong meulawan ngon tungkat. Barô watèë makhluk ubit bumoë djimakheun rot tungkat njan, ureuëng-ureuëng njang na di seukitar ulôn djisadar bahwa ulôn ka lheuëh.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
